goblet-squat.name: Goblet squat
cues: Bell at your chest, elbows down.
Sit between your heels, chest tall.
Knees track over your middle toes.
goblet-squat.x: Heels lifting? Widen your stance slightly.
goblet-squat.setup: Bell held by the horns · feet just wider than hips

kb-swing.name: Kettlebell swing
cues: Bell a foot in front; hinge and grab it.
Hike it back high between your thighs.
Snap hips forward, bell floats to chest height.
Arms are ropes; the hips do the work.
kb-swing.x: Lifting with your arms? Hinge more.

farmer-carry.name: Farmer carry
cues: Pick up like a deadlift, flat back.
Tall posture, shoulders down and back.
farmer-carry.setup: Clear a straight path, shoes on

video.q: farmers carry how to Squat University

long-everything.name: Single-arm dumbbell Romanian deadlift to bent-over row with a pause
long-everything.setup: Blackwing flat at the end of the mat · one dumbbell in your right hand, overhand grip · left hand on the bench pad for balance · shoes on, feet hip-width
cues: Soft knees, then push your hips straight back like closing a car door with your butt.
Let the bell slide down the front of your leg until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Hold the bottom, keep your back flat, and pull your elbow up toward your hip.
Lower the bell under control, then squeeze your glutes to stand all the way up.
Switch hands after every set and match the reps on the weaker side.
Breathe out as you stand; reset your grip and posture before the next rep.
long-everything.x: Back rounding or the bell drifting away from your leg? Stop higher, go lighter, and keep the bell close the whole time.
